gdir.definition: G-dir current tap: c = silu(alpha * z), z = N_conv(u) with norm weight 0 = v/rms(v) (gate cancels). target rms(c) = r * rms(h_host) with r = Flash-Next median conv_rms/x_rms per stream; alpha solves rms(silu(alpha z)) = target on the measured z of Flash-Next's own values

gdir_mandatory.rule: conv >= 2x direct on the median token in >= 2 of 4 streams

calibrated_gate.rule: >= 50% of gate-logit variance within n-grams (groups = identical 3-gram hash context, i.e. identical e_t)
